description: Robinhood Chain as a whole right now, in one call: 24h DEX volume, liquidity and trades across the pools of every stock token and the 100 most-traded tokens (DexScreener), volume by venue and the top pools, the stock tokens furthest from Robinhood's price, the median gap and stock-token volume over the last days, the live Pons launches that raised the most with Stoa's safety verdict, how far apart venues quote the same swap, and Spotlight, next to the whole crypto market from CoinMarketCap (total market cap and 24h change, BTC and ETH, Fear and Greed). Kept five minutes. Use it for a market overview before going into one token.
name: robinhood_chain_today
title: Robinhood Chain today
